summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py per docs/CONVENTIONS.md: integer cents, leftover cents go one each to the earliest entries, negative totals (refunds) split by absolute value and negated, and zero or negative party counts raise ValueError. Added tests for remainder distribution, refunds, a single party, zero total and invalid counts; all 7 tests pass.
assumptions: Zero total returns a list of zeros of length parties, since zero is a valid amount.
Non-integer inputs are not explicitly validated; the function relies on integer cents as documented in ledger/money.py.
Refund handling follows CONVENTIONS.md rule 4 literally: earliest entries carry the larger refund magnitude.
